# Jig and FLOW

Jig is a local, secure host for admitted FLOW packages.

- Landing page: https://flow.jig.md/
- Documentation map: https://flow.jig.md/guide/
- Source and quickstart: https://github.com/jigmd/jig#readme
- FLOW Package/1: https://flow.jig.md/spec/package-format
- FLOW Run/1: https://flow.jig.md/spec/run-protocol
- FLOW Run SDK/1: https://flow.jig.md/spec/run-sdk
- FLOW Schema/1: https://flow.jig.md/spec/schema-files
- Jig project policy: https://flow.jig.md/spec/project-policy
- Security boundary: https://github.com/jigmd/jig/blob/main/SECURITY.md
